description: 20430-05-01-2 臺中市天然氣供氣戶數及供氣量 [gas networks] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺中市政府經濟發展局. 由臺中市公用天然氣事業提供每月供氣戶數與供氣量統計資料，為公共資訊提供者，內含供氣戶數及供氣量的統計數據，能源管理可供研究者、政策制定者及公民參與決策等各界使用。. Coverage: 臺中市政府經濟發展局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺中市政府經濟發展局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json, csv. The portal shows 2026-09-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
